summary: Nicola Mining filed a Form 6-K with a Material Change Report disclosing that it and Ocean Partners UK committed a combined $10.0 million financing to Blue Lagoon Resources for the Dome Mountain Gold and Silver Project. Nicola invested $5.0 million via a private placement at CAD $0.60 per share, acquiring 8,333,333 common shares, building on an earlier $1.0 million investment at $0.14 per share. Ocean Partners contributed $5.0 million, bringing its total to $8.0 million. No board recommendation or advisors named. This is a strategic equity investment, not a special-situation corporate event; watch for subsequent financing milestones.
